evidence_quotes.O: For the amount of abuse I've put it through as my walkaround lens, it's handled the abuse/dust/dirt perfectly in over 25 countries.
evidence_quotes.C: Before I made this my drive for Time Machine backups, I gave it a thorough beating by copying hundreds of GBs of photos from my desktop to my new Macbook.
evidence_quotes.E: The swiveling lens is awesome - I can mount this at weird angles or something low profile - something the boxy GoPro Hero can't really do.
evidence_quotes.A: So, after I've thoroughly said how much this bag won't work for me, who will it work for?
evidence_quotes.N: There are minor gripes. The drive is solidly built but very thin so I'm worried that I'll somehow snap it in half.
